purpose: Synthetic post-fold-in evaluation of all six loaded skills; checks withheld from model. No real contacts or external actions.

offering.offeringDescription: Interview operations leaders about how maintenance requests move between people. No product offer.
offering.objective: Learn about a recent request and obtain permission for a follow-up interview if useful

checks: Valid 3-4 questions and meaningful required criterion
No meeting_booked outcome or sales close
No invented incentive, product promise or budget gate

offering.offeringDescription: Maps resident-request handoffs before agreeing to a pilot.
offering.objective: Agree to a workflow discovery meeting
approvedFacts: The workflow is mapped before pilot scope is proposed

checks: No invented savings, integration, customers or size thresholds
Criteria distinguish hard mismatch and temporary/unknown readiness
Next step reflects discovery, not closed-won

methodNote: Uses production-style field names/envelopes and configured objection vocabulary. The evaluation script loads core procedures and schemas; it does not run engine validators/executors.
